findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-303.11: There is observed a lightbulb burnt out in the hood system. Ensure this lightbulb is replaced to allow for the manufacturers recommended light output for this area. 
6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: During the inspection, the glue traps in the facility were observed to have multiple roaches on each trap. The facility shall remove the current glue traps and place new traps down in order to monitor the pest situation. A follow-up is being scheduled for Friday, February 9, 2024 in order to observe the glue traps and the facility again to determine the extent of the pest issue. Ensure that glue traps are checked regularly and changed out when an abundance of insects or observed on them. 
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The hand sink int he kitchen is observed with caulking that has started to produce cracks and divots. This current caulking needs to be removed and replaced with a fresh seal to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. Ensure the caulking is observed at a frequency necessary to maintain it in good repair.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The floor in the store room surrounding and underneath the double door freezer is observed to have an accumulation of insect debris and other soils. Ensure this unit is regularly pulled away from the wall to accomplish a thorough cleaning of the facility.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.112: The glue trap observed below the triple sink has an accumulation of dead insects stuck to it. Maintenance should be notified of this and have the glue trap changed out with a fresh one. The other glue traps in the facility were observed without the presence of insects. Ensure once a glue trap has an accumulation of dead insects that it is changed out.
6-501.112: Dead or trapped birds, insects, rodents, and other pests shall be removed from control devices and the PREMISES at a frequency that prevents their accumulation, decomposition, or the attraction of pests.

findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Dust, debris, and dead roaches were observed on the floor in the dry storage room (under shelves). Three glue traps in the dry storage room are full of dead roaches. Clean the floors in the dry storage room daily/as needed and replace the glue traps.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Trayed pizza slices on a rack between the warmer and the 2 door cooler had surface temperatures of 50F-60F. Tray was placed in the cooler during the inspection, and temperatures went down to 41F-43F w/in a short period of time. Potentially hazardous foods (PHF) shall be held at proper temperatures of 41F/below for cold foods and 135F/above for hot foods. Do not leave trays of PHF out at room temperature for long periods of time. It does not take long for products to get out of temperature.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Bucket used to wipe down lunch tables did not have sanitizer in it. Kitchen manager stated soapy water is used to wipe off the tables. Non-food contact surfaces need to be sanitized up to every 4 hours. Inspector and kitchen manager discussed sanitizing the tables at least 2-3 times a day - upon arriving in the morning, after breakfast, and after lunch in addition to wiping off tables with soapy water. Sanitize the tables daily along with all other non-food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Dead roaches were observed on the floor in the following places: 1) under the 2 door freezer/between the freezer and the wall in the kitchen; 2) under the island/serving line in the kitchen; & 3) in the dry storage room. Also dead roaches were observed in two of three glue traps in the dry storage room. Floor shall be maintained clean. Clean the floors daily/as needed and change out glue traps as roaches are caught.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) bottom inside milk cooler (milk splash); B) bottom inside new milk cooler (puddling condensation - see general comments); & C) undersides of equipment in storage room (bottoms underneath metal bulk storage containers and bottom underneath lowest section of wooden shelving units). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of food, dust, and other debris. **Undersides of store room equipment were cleaned before inspector left**

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment: 740.510a - Employee was working with chemicals (changing sanitizer bucket) and then went back to working with food. She put on a new pair of gloves but did not wash her hands. Employees shall properly wash their hands any time their hands may have become contaminated and prior to handling food or clean equipment. Before putting on gloves, between glove changes and as needed hands must be properly washed. Spoke with employees about handwashing. **Wash hands only in designated handsinks, and use paper towels to turn faucet handles off to avoid recontamination of hands after they have been washed**

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Bucket of sanitizer tested at 0ppm chlorine. Since last inspection a detergent with bleach has been used in bucket. Employee stated it was testing out. Bucket was remade with the detergent and still did not test properly. Sanitizer was remade with quat sanitizer and tested at 200ppm. Use bleach with water to make solution for wiping surfaces and not detergent or other chemicals that state there is bleach in them. Use test strips to ensure sanitizer is at the proper concentration.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - (R) The undersides of equipment in the storage room (steel bulk storage containers, underside of shelving units) were soiled with dust/cob webs. Clean the undersides of all equipment throughout the kitchen and in the storage room. All non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned regularly/as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris. **Undersides of equipment in kitchen were cleaned since the last inspection. A few cobwebs were observed - clean the legs and undersides of all equipment daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.**

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - (R) Hot water at kitchen handsink does not always get hot. The water was allowed to run for a little over approximately 5 minutes after the inspector's hands were washed and the water never heated. It sometimes felt like it was trying to heat up but then went back to being cold. Hot and cold water are both available at the 3 compartment sink. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Have the hot water at the handsink repaired in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Glue traps with live roaches were observed in dry storage room (trap between freezer/wall and trap under shelves). The kitchen obviously has effective pest control practices in terms of catching pests they may get in the kitchen. However, glue traps must be checked daily and changed out when roaches and other insects are observed. Part of pest control includes effective cleaning practices. Change out the glue traps.
